signals.note: Torque custom PID 22054B, equation A; an F-150 owner says it matches the cluster. OBDb Ford-Focus/Escape: same. Only PCMs with the Intelligent Oil Life Monitor answer (mostly NA calibrations).

Torque built-in '[FORD]Transmission Temp' = 221E1C; custom-PID form (((signed(A)*256)+B)*(9/8)+320)/10 °F = raw/16 °C. OBDb Explorer: 7E0, signed /16 °C. Answers where the PCM runs the gearbox (6F35/6F50).
Same DID/scaling asked from a separate TCM at 7E1 (PowerShift DPS6, Aisin AW F21). 7E1 221E1C is confirmed on Ford-derived Mazda TCMs; for Ford Focus/Fiesta no public source confirms the 7E1 address.
OBDb Ford-Focus 221310 = (A*256+B)/100-40; same DID/formula in the mazdas247 Skyactiv list (Ford-style PCM). No Ford-owner confirmation found.
Torque 220415 = ((A*256)+B)*0.145 psi, i.e. raw kPa; OBDb Ford-Focus: signed kPa. Only engines with an oil pressure sensor.
OBDb Ford-Focus/Explorer/Fusion: 7E0 22DD01, 24-bit km; the mazdas247 Skyactiv list has the same DID/formula.
BCM battery monitoring sensor (cars with start/stop or smart charging). OBDb Ford-Focus 726 224028 = A %; the Skyactiv list has the same at 726.
OBDb Ford-Focus 726 224029 = A-40; the Skyactiv list has the same at 726.
